:::{#exm-conj-product}
#### Multiplying $3 + 4\,i$ by its conjugate

$$
\ba
&(3 + 4\,i)(3 - 4\,i)
\\
&= 9 - 12\,i + 12\,i - 16\,i^2
&& \text{(distribute)}
\\
&= 9 - 16\,i^2
&& \text{(cancel } 12\,i \text{)}
\\
&= 9 + 16
&& \text{(@def-imaginary-unit)}
\\
&= 25
&& \text{(add)}
\ea
$$

which is $\abs{3 + 4\,i}^2 = 5^2$ from @exm-complex-modulus, as @thm-conj-product says.

:::
